how_to_run: Give the agent the query with the slim-sheet MCP attached and the file in its allowed root. Grade each expectation as pass/fail by reading the tool calls and the output workbook (or run anomalies scope='client' on it).

evals.query: Build a CFO dashboard from sales_2026.xlsx showing how we did against budget and last year.
files: sales_2026.xlsx (Data sheet: Month, Business unit, Revenue (USD m), Revenue PY (USD m), Revenue budget (USD m), Opex (USD m), Opex budget (USD m))
expected: calls overview before build_report
revenue KPI has both |vs: (PY) and |plan: (budget) segments
opex KPI uses |plan: and is not presented as good when above budget
messages contain numbers and a comparison, no invented figures
runs anomalies scope='client' and reports remaining findings

evals.query: Prepare a one-page board summary of this year's results. Show me the plan first.
files: results.xlsx (Quarter, Segment, Revenue (USD m), Revenue plan (USD m), Net profit (USD m))
expected: replies with a plan (KPIs, charts, messages) and waits before editing
at most 5 KPIs and 3 charts or tables
title is a sentence stating the result

evals.query: Monthly sales review for the regional heads: quota attainment, regions and top customers.
files: sales.xlsx (Month, Region, Customer, Revenue (USD k), Quota (USD k))
expected: uses |plan:Quota (USD k):quota on revenue
includes a table:Customer:Revenue (USD k) item
uses rank:Region for regions

evals.query: Make a dashboard from orders.csv for our client meeting.
files: orders.csv (Date, Product, Units, Revenue) with no prior period or plan
expected: does not invent a prior period or a plan
says that no comparison base exists and suggests adding one
converts or reads the CSV and still builds a dashboard

evals.query: This workbook looks unprofessional. Fix it for the client without changing the numbers.
files: pack.xlsx (several summary tables with charts made by another tool)
expected: uses style_sheet on tables and preset='charts' on chart-only sheets
does not overwrite the original file
runs anomalies scope='client' before and after

evals.query: Lập dashboard kết quả kinh doanh 9 tháng cho khách hàng, so với kế hoạch và cùng kỳ.
files: kqkd.xlsx (Tháng, Chi nhánh, DT 2026, DT 2025, DT KH, LNST 2026, LNST KH)
expected: uses brand='vn'
uses |plan:DT KH:KH and |vs:DT 2025:cùng kỳ
subtitle states the unit (Đơn vị tính)
